wins: Maintained a high reward score (67.5) by efficiently enumerating exposed services and mapping network topology within the single episode.
Leveraged multiple mentor hints (15 calls) to quickly identify service banners and prioritize targets, demonstrating adaptability under guidance.
fails: Objective not completed – success rate remains 0.00%; no final exploitation or control achieved.
Repeatedly stalled at privilege escalation due to incomplete credential harvesting and lack of automated escalation routines.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance and service discovery phase produced high reward, but closure failed due to ineffective credential reuse and privilege escalation gaps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to translate service enumeration into actionable credentials for pivoting, leaving the mission incomplete after initial access.

skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted sshv1/ssh2 brute-force and banner-specific nmap scripts

skill_cards.then_action: Execute spidering with dirb/Burp intruder to enumerate hidden endpoints before credential harvesting
